mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` (order_no, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, total_amount, status, pay_time, ship_time, receive_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{payTime}, #{shipTime}, #{receiveTime}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `order` WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM `order` ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
